summary: Three churches (St. Joseph, St. Patrick, St. Mary of the Snows). The two-page newest bulletin and four older ones agree on the Mass times box: weekend and weekday Masses, Confession, Mon-Fri 7:15 AM Exposition Holy Hour and Wednesday 5:30 PM Holy Hour. Wednesday's 8:30 Mass is at St. Patrick, not St. Joseph. The seasonal 11:15 Sunday Mass at St. Mary of the Snows (Memorial Day to Columbus Day) is left out as out of season. No open questions.

slots.rationale: R33: the 11:15 Mass at St. Mary of the Snows is seasonal, Memorial Day to Columbus Day (the parish website; Columbus Day was October 12). It appears in intentions through Oct 11, is absent from the Oct 18 and Oct 25 bulletins, and is never in the Mass times box. Memorial Day and Columbus Day are not fixed dates, so the file cannot express the season, and it is out of season now. The website's weekday times conflict with the bulletins, so it is not used for any time. Update mode will see it return next year.
